chapter: Europe and the Black and Blue years
title: Hugues Panassie and his wife follow her tours
summary: Panassie and his wife Natalie always turned up wherever she sang in France, and Panassie marveled that even young people loved her and wanted her to keep singing. The text is broken by an out-of-order page.

blocks.x: Yeah and you know Mr. Panassie said one time, when ever I come over there he and his wife . .

Yes. They always come where I was. And I'd go somewhere and I'd look up and the first thing I'd see would be him and his wife. And he said, 'you know Helen I just can't understand it. It just seems like these people just love you so and they don't never want you to stop singing.' He said, 'even the younger people.
